name: organon

Uses the claude.ai-hosted Organon connector (mcp-tools-istefox ≥ 2.1.0, obsidian-mcp.folot.net) for the remote Obsidian MCP server — no bundled .mcp.json; Cloudflare Access OAuth on first connect.
